# Contributing to Friendly Project

Thanks for helping out. Please follow these rules:

- You must open an issue before submitting a pull request.
- All commits must be signed off — we enforce DCO. Use `git commit --signoff`.
- We use conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …).
- Run `npm test` and make sure all tests pass before opening a PR.
- Lint your changes with `npm run lint`; CI will fail otherwise.
- Pull requests need at least one maintainer review.

## Pull request template

Fill in the problem, the change, and how you verified it.
